text:
Taylor R.: FYI i opened a small PR to unify the tool/action envelopes and add a short backcompat note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892. want to avoid surprising examples for people on older SDKs.
Mina V.: thanks. which envelope are we standardizing on? saw mixed examples across py/js/go.
Taylor R.: canonical is the action-response envelope: { action: \"name\", args: {...}, response: { status, payload } }. i'll also add a tiny example showing payload: null for 204-ish cases.
Omar C.: agree with canonical. one ask: please keep a one-line mapping for older SDKs that used invoke/tool_call so people can search and find it easily.
Taylor R.: good call. plan: add a migration blurb in /guides/migration and leave anchors on the old pages. avoiding mass-redirects for now.
Mina V.: heads-up: Hugo renderer was dropping leading spaces in fenced blocks in the last build. remove any leading indentation on triple-backtick blocks. i fixed two in the PR.
Taylor R.: updated. also trimmed the gigantic long_examples.md into examples/expanded and left the minimal canonical snippets on the main guide.
Omar C.: can you paste the minimal snippet you'll keep? want to sanity-check the JSON shape for the Go SDK docs.
Taylor R.: here's the snippet I'm keeping:
```json
{
  \"action\": \"fetch_profile\",
  \"args\": { \"user_id\": \"u_123\" },
  \"response\": { \"status\": \"ok\", \"payload\": null }
}
```
Mina V.: looks good. in JS snippet prefer client.callAction('fetch_profile', { user_id }) rather than client.invoke.
Omar C.: and in Go i'll add a tiny adapter example showing mapping of response.payload to a pointer type so null maps to nil. i'll put that in examples/expanded/interop.md.
Taylor R.: dev-helper run link-check?
linter-bot: link-checker: detected 6 broken links in docs/guides/structured-output (CI job #1102).
Mina V.: i'll triage the remaining broken links after lunch. most are old anchors that used to live in long_examples.md.
Taylor R.: blocker: need markdown-lint green before merge. last time frontmatter spacing caused build to fail.
Omar C.: i'll run markdown-lint and prettier on my changes and push fixes if any.
Mina V.: small editorial nit: explain why payload can be null vs {} in one sentence so folks don't assume empty object means success.
Taylor R.: added sentence: \"payload may be null to indicate absence of a resource (similar to HTTP 204); clients should treat null as no-data rather than an error.\"
Mina V.: LGTM. leaving a quick JS snippet tweak comment in the PR.
linter-bot: docs-build: preview available at https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4892. link-checker now reports 0 failures.
Taylor R.: merged 389 :tada: thanks everyone. follow-up: i'll schedule a short notes doc capturing the tooling checklist for next spec change (lint, link-check, SDK grep, backcompat blurb).
